## Activity

During July 2020, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 9 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. The activity record is presented as captures completed at the site during July 2020.

## Image quality

Of the 9 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 11.1. This result identifies the proportion of captured images that could not be graded and should be considered alongside the total activity for Hill Counties Health Centre. The image-quality result is reported separately from the grading outcome.

## Grading

There were 2 referable results among the captures recorded in July 2020. The median grading lag was 1. This is the median interval reported for grading during the month. Together, the referable result and the median grading lag describe the grading outcomes associated with the site’s activity. The figures in this report are limited to the reported capture volume, image-quality result, referable result, and grading lag for Hill Counties Health Centre.
